findings.highlight: my shoulders are being crushed
findings.evidenceJa: 肩ごと左腕を砕かれたような感覚
findings.governingReading: the sensation that his left arm, shoulder and all, has been crushed
findings.explanation: A unilateral injury sensation becomes the crushing of both shoulders and drops the arm.

findings.highlight: I almost drop my swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 短剣を落としかける。
findings.governingReading: He nearly drops the shortsword.
findings.explanation: One affected hand and blade become both swords.

findings.highlight: the fist going for my temple
findings.evidenceJa: 眉間に繰り出される拳
findings.governingReading: the fist driven at the space between his brows
findings.explanation: The strike moves from the center of Shirou’s forehead to the side of his head.

findings.highlight: block Kuzuki’s fist with the shortswords.
findings.evidenceJa: 葛木の蛇に短剣を合わせる。
findings.governingReading: He matches his shortswords against Kuzuki’s “Snake.”
findings.explanation: The named fighting method is reduced to one fist, and a singular shortsword becomes plural.

findings.highlight: Can I stay alive until my magical energy runs out?
findings.evidenceJa: あと二本使い切れる余裕など、この体のどこに
findings.governingReading: Where in this body is there enough reserve to use up even the last two blades?
findings.explanation: A question about bodily capacity to survive two more Projections becomes a question about lasting until mana depletion.

findings.highlight: The fist he hadn’t been using
findings.evidenceJa: 常に不動だったソレ
findings.governingReading: that right fist, which until then had remained perfectly motionless
findings.explanation: The tactical fact that the fist never moved becomes only non-use.

findings.highlight: I shielded my chest with my blades.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を肋ごと貫こうとするその一撃
findings.governingReading: He receives on the twin blades a blow intended to pierce his chest together with his ribs.
findings.explanation: The intended penetrating anatomy and Kuzuki’s attacking agency disappear.

findings.highlight: The devil approaches.
findings.evidenceJa: 幽鬼が迫る。
findings.governingReading: The ghost or specter closes in.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s recurring ghostlike image becomes a theological monster.

findings.highlight: surrounded by divine mysteries of ancient lore.
findings.evidenceJa: 歯車を回す神秘を帯びている。
findings.governingReading: she perpetually bears the Mystery that turns the world’s gears
findings.explanation: A functional metaphysical image becomes nonspecific ancient lore surrounding Caster.

findings.highlight: simple magic from the Magic Crest
findings.evidenceJa: 左手の魔術刻印による簡易詠唱
findings.governingReading: a simplified incantation through the Magic Crest on her left hand
findings.explanation: A casting procedure becomes a weaker type of magic, and the crest’s bodily location disappears.

findings.highlight: Crystallization of magical energy that she has stored since she was born as a magus.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の娘として生を受け、今まで貯めに貯めてきた十年分以上の魔力の結晶。
findings.governingReading: crystals of more than ten years of magical energy, accumulated since she was born as a magus’s daughter
findings.explanation: The explicit duration and inherited family position disappear, while Rin herself is incorrectly said to have been born already a magus.

findings.highlight: Kuzuki should be protected by Caster, but he is an exception.
findings.evidenceJa: 葛木はキャスターによって護られているだろうが、彼だけは例外なのだ。
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki is probably protected by Caster, but Shirou alone is the exception to that protection.
findings.explanation: The English leaves “he” sounding like Kuzuki, obscuring that Shirou is the unprotected person who would burn.

findings.highlight: That is good faith
findings.evidenceJa: 大した信念ですけど
findings.governingReading: That is quite a conviction
findings.explanation: Caster’s mock respect for Rin’s resolve becomes the unrelated notion of good faith.

findings.highlight: The first one to run out of magical energy will die.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力が尽きた方が敗北する。
findings.governingReading: Whichever side exhausts its magical energy loses.
findings.explanation: Defeat in the magical contest is strengthened into literal death.

findings.highlight: You can’t use magic surpassing your own level.
findings.evidenceJa: 術者の許容量を上回る魔術は、決して使ってはならない
findings.governingReading: One must never use Magecraft that exceeds the practitioner’s capacity.
findings.explanation: An absolute bodily-capacity prohibition becomes an informal rule about abstract level.

findings.highlight: even if she has a hundred jewels
findings.evidenceJa: 百の宝石を重ねても
findings.governingReading: even if she layered a hundred jewels together
findings.explanation: The hypothetical combined amplification of one hundred jewels becomes mere possession of them.

findings.highlight: you have value just because of that.
findings.evidenceJa: それだけでも貴女に価値を与えましょう
findings.governingReading: for that alone, I shall grant you some value
findings.explanation: Caster’s arrogated authority to confer worth on Rin becomes a statement that Rin inherently has value.

findings.highlight: She has been waiting for this.
findings.evidenceJa: その断定こそを、彼女はずっと待っていた。
findings.governingReading: That very certainty and declaration was what Rin had been waiting for.
findings.explanation: The exact trigger—Caster’s certainty that victory is complete—becomes an unspecified “this.”

findings.highlight: Tohsaka charged in and attacked Caster!
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく気合いの入った姿勢で
findings.governingReading: Rin charged Caster in an outrageously committed fighting posture.
findings.explanation: The visually comic intensity that produces Shirou’s astonishment disappears.

findings.highlight: she attacks Caster.
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターへと跳びかかった。
findings.governingReading: she leaps bodily upon Caster
findings.explanation: Rin’s airborne commitment through her own fire becomes a generic attack.

findings.highlight: a move from Chinese martial arts
findings.evidenceJa: 中国拳法でいうところの寸頸
findings.governingReading: the technique Chinese martial arts calls the one-inch strike
findings.explanation: The named close-range technique explaining Rin’s short chest blow disappears.

findings.highlight: She lashes out her foot with all her might
findings.evidenceJa: 体ごと回す旋脚
findings.governingReading: a wheeling sweep driven by the rotation of her whole body
findings.explanation: The full-body rotational mechanics become a generic forceful foot motion.

findings.highlight: “Take this…!”
findings.governingReading: “Fly…!”
findings.explanation: Rin’s command predicts and punctuates the launch produced by her punch; the English replaces it with a generic attack cry.

findings.highlight: punches with all her
findings.evidenceJa: とんでもなく腰の入った正拳
findings.governingReading: an extraordinary hip-driven straight punch
findings.explanation: The named straight punch and its hip mechanics become generic weight.

findings.highlight: Taking the punch directly
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の正拳突きをまともに受けた
findings.governingReading: taking Rin’s straight punch squarely
findings.explanation: The specific final technique is again reduced to an ordinary punch.

findings.highlight: She challenged Caster at magic
findings.evidenceJa: あえて不利な魔術戦を演じたのか。
findings.governingReading: She deliberately performed a losing magical contest as bait.
findings.explanation: The intentional disadvantage and theatrical deception that enable the surprise attack disappear.

findings.highlight: her arms dangling as if broken.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の両手は、骨折したようにだらりと下げられていた。
findings.governingReading: both of Rin’s hands hang limp as though broken
findings.explanation: The apparent injury moves from both hands to the full arms.

findings.highlight: smashes into the wall opposite me
findings.evidenceJa: 正反対の壁際まで弾かれた
findings.governingReading: is flung as far as the wall on the side opposite Shirou
findings.explanation: The source places Rin at the opposite wall’s edge; the English asserts another direct wall impact.

findings.highlight: He speaks plainly.
findings.evidenceJa: 平然と言う。
findings.governingReading: He says it with complete composure.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s unruffled affect becomes clarity of wording.

findings.highlight: Kuzuki’s ability
findings.evidenceJa: 卓越した格闘スキル
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki Souichirou’s outstanding close-combat skill
findings.explanation: The exact domain and exceptional degree of Kuzuki’s ability disappear.
